Web.ArchLinux.Types

Contents

  • Arch Linux official
  • AUR

Description

This module defines types and their serializations used in API.

Fields' names are prefixed with _ for lenses generation, consider using Web.ArchLinux.Types.Lens to access data types smoothly.
